name: Rewrite
description: Rewrite for clarity and flow, guided by the selected persona. Meaning stays the same.
instruction: Rewrite the text according to the persona. Preserve meaning. Improve clarity and flow.

name: Summarise (TL;DR)
description: 3–6 bullets with concrete facts and outcomes. No waffle.
instruction: Summarise the text into a TL;DR with 3–6 bullets. Keep concrete facts. Avoid vague statements.

name: Summarise (Executive)
description: Short executive summary with decisions, risks, and next steps.
instruction: Summarise for an executive audience. Include: Key points, Decisions (if any), Risks/concerns (if any), Next steps.
output_format: Return Markdown with headings and bullet points. Keep it concise.

name: Reformat (Markdown)
description: Turns messy text into clean Markdown with headings and bullet lists where appropriate.
instruction: Reformat the text into clean Markdown with sensible headings and bullet lists where appropriate. Keep it readable.

name: Remove fluff
description: Cuts filler, repetition, hedging, and robotic phrasing while keeping meaning intact.
instruction: Remove filler, repetition, hedging, and robotic phrasing. Keep the same meaning. Preserve any technical details and proper nouns.

name: Replace (AI-assisted)
description: Rewrites the text while replacing terms or phrasing based on the extra instruction.
instruction: Rewrite the text while applying the user's extra instruction as the source of truth for what to replace or change. Preserve meaning outside of those requested changes.

name: Expand
description: Adds helpful detail and clarity, with examples where safe. Does not invent facts.
instruction: Expand the text to add helpful detail, clarification, and examples. Do not invent facts; if unknown, keep it general and label assumptions as assumptions.

name: Extract: Action items
description: Finds action items and owners where possible. If none, says so.
instruction: Extract explicit action items. If an owner is implied, include it. If none, say 'No explicit action items found.'
output_format: Return Markdown with heading '## Action items' and a bullet list.

name: Extract: Risks
description: Lists risks, impacts, and mitigations where present in the text.
instruction: Extract risks mentioned or implied by the text. For each risk, include: Risk, Impact, Suggested mitigation (based only on the text; do not invent). If none, say 'No clear risks found.'
output_format: Return Markdown with heading '## Risks' and bullet points.

name: Extract: Entities
description: Pulls out people, systems, organisations, dates, and key terms.
instruction: Extract structured entities from the text: People, Organisations, Systems/Tools, Dates, Key terms. Only include items present in the text.
output_format: Return Markdown headings for each category with bullet lists.
